title: ORGAN SPARING FOR LOCALLY ADVANCED RECTAL CANCER AFTER NEOADJUVANT TREATMENT FOLLOWED BY ELECTROCHEMOTHERAPY - LARC_ DEEP_CANCERS
official: ORGAN SPARING FOR LOCALLY ADVANCED RECTAL CANCER AFTER NEOADJUVANT TREATMENT FOLLOWED BY ELECTROCHEMOTHERAPY -  LARC_ DEEP_CANCERS
summary: Main objective: Evaluation of the safety and feasibility of the procedure and of the increase of the complete response rate with the aim of organ sparing. Evaluated by histopathological analysis based on TRG performed on specimen exported from local excision.
